labIdeas: In COMP2xxx1 Database Systems, students learn SQL by designing and querying a normalized relational schema, supporting the outcome 'Express queries in relational algebra and a declarative query language'.
COMP3xxx1 Deep Learning adds PyTorch skills by implementing convolutional networks and diagnosing training issues, reinforcing 'Design convolutional networks for image classification'.
COMP1xxx3 Computer Systems and the Command Line introduces Docker by containerizing C programs and Linux environments, enhancing 'Work confidently at a Linux command line'.
